articleTitle: YOLO v5 for SDSB Distant Tiny Object Detection
abstract: To reach SDSB (Self-Driving Sweeping Bot) in an efficient-sweeping manner, data collection of visual images regarding sweeping target must be conducted prior to analyze the required sweeping objects with other noises. In this work, three categorized target objects including, fallen leaves, speed bumps and manhole cover etc. are involved in training and validation phases. To reach SDSB with real-time object detection, the work further investigated one-stage of Yolo v5 learning approach of four version including, Yolo v5s, Yolo v5m, Yolo v51, and Yolo v5x, wherein Yolo v5s in terms of its benefits on lower frame rate, high-accuracy, and high-speed characteristics for real-time object detection. Furthermore, to detailed analyze the Yolo v5s performance on training and validation set, several indices including, box loss, objectness loss, classification loss, precision, recall and mean average precision (mAP) in terms of epoch number, are also reported in the experiments.

articleTitle: Tuberculosis Detection Based on Multiple Model Ensemble in Chest X-ray Image
abstract: Tuberculosis is a legal infectious lung disease, a chronic infectious disease caused by tuberculosis. The diagnosis of the confirmed person is usually judged by chest X-ray images, and the sputum smear is used to detect the presence of tuberculosis in the sputum. Screening high-risk individuals can effectively prevent the spread of tuberculosis; however, chest X-ray image interpretation and sputum testing take a long time. When infectious tuberculosis patients are found, tuberculosis has already spread. We propose a tuberculosis diagnostic triage system and a tuberculosis detection system based on preprocessing of lung image segmentation. In the tuberculosis diagnosis and triage system, AI interpretation is performed immediately after the patient's chest X-ray is taken, and abnormal tuberculosis cases are immediately listed. Lung field cropping through U-Net for classification in the form of a multiple ensemble system, including the use of EfficientNet-BO, Densenet121, and Xception. After marking abnormal lung images, we use a tuberculosis detection system to find patients with tuberculosis and use GRAD-Cam to display the image areas that are of most interest to the model, similar to a heat map, allowing us to know the model Predicting focus areas for tuberculosis. We used specificity, sensitivity, accuracy, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) to evaluate the classification model performance.

articleTitle: Happiness and Fashion Culture of Smart Kidswear from the perspective of Metaverse
abstract: This research introduces the research on children's intelligent design from the perspective of Metaverse, including the concept of Metaverse, the research status of Metaverse brand at home and abroad, This paper introduces the research on the problems to be solved, the technical route, the scheme design as well as feasibility analysis. It mainly studies the sustainability and brand marketing model of smart kidswear combined with Metaverse sales, so as to provide assistance for the development of smart kidswear happiness design under the condition of Metaverse.

articleTitle: Exploration and Research on Digital Education Scenarios from the Perspective of Metaverse
abstract: The term “metaverse” has become one of the most popular in recent years. Its immersion, low barrier, diversity, anytime, anywhere provided by technology creates a large area for educational scene investigation and research. The use of the metaverse in education creates new opportunities, promotes augmented reality, life milestones, virtual reality, and mirror worlds, among other things. Metaverse also provides new fields, virtual classrooms, and teachers for learners in the learning process, as well as a convenient way to organize scenario simulation instruction, design scientifically, and locate properly in the education scenario. Furthermore, Constructive learning results and social learning effects are realized in such a virtual learning setting, promoting the reform of the digital education mode. It promotes a deep integration of the metaverse with educational practice.

articleTitle: Attention-based U-Net extensions for Complex Noises of Smart Campus Road Segmentation
abstract: The previous work investigated SDSB (Self-Driving Sweeping Bot) visual intelligence in terms of road segmentation for constraint sweeping area and sweeping efficiency. To do so, this paper explores the U-Net learning approach with three extensions on Pred U-Net, Pred resU-Net and Pred AttresU-Net, and validated multiple weather conditions of road images, including, fully cloudy, full sunshine, partially sunshine shadowing by giant trees or facilities etc. In addition, the road surrounding with complex objects, such as, cracks, roads traffic signs, white arrows and lines, manhole cover and zebra crossings etc. are also considered and analyzed. The experimental result is shown that the Pred AttresU-Net for road segmentation given the superior segmented efficiency compared with Pred U-Net and Pred resU-Net.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Audio Super Resolution and Noise Cancellation System for Low Sampling Rate Noise Environment
abstract: The fire department's disaster relief center receives an average of hundreds of thousands of ambulance calls every year, among which the ambulance center dispatches and guides relevant ambulances and ambulance personnel to the scene through a wireless notification system. Ambulance personnel must continue to guide and communicate through radio during the rescue process in the fire scene. In an emergency, the clarity of radio listening information is the first requirement to strengthen the judgment of the ambulance personnel and strive to save lives in a short time. Usually the sampling rate of the general radio is 8KHz, and the disaster relief site is easy to receive a lot of noise, so it is very important to improve the sampling frequency of radio communication and noise cancellation. By integrating two deep learning models Unet+AFiLM [1] and I-DTLN into audio super-resolution and noise cancellation system, which can effectively remove noise in radio communication and increase the audio sampling rate to enhance the effect of speech recognition.

articleTitle: Human Knowledge and Visual Intelligence on SDXtensionB
abstract: The Self-Driving Sweeper Bot (SDSB) was previously reported by incorporated the Self-Driving system with the Sweeper mechanism, after several months and numerous times of running test at a pre-planned close-loop campus route, our observation with the best knowledge indicates that SDSB is extendable to be SDX<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">tension</sup>B, such as SD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">LM</sup>B incorporated Self-Driving Bot with Lawn Mower mechanism, SDPB integrated Self-Driving Bot with Paver mechanism and SD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SK</sup>B is together the Self-Driving Bot with StacKer etc. To reach SDX<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">tension</sup>B with visual intelligence and human knowledge capabilities, the observation further reports that three important issues have to be further inspecting, including, 1) complex environmental noises for machine visual learning, 2) modelling trigger-event for failed event to functionality restoration, and 3) sensors security against hacker remote control. Besides that, the investigation on SDSB visual intelligence in terms of road segmentation, rubbish, pedestrian and vehicle detections by YOLO and U-net extension approaches were validated on its promising accuracy and feasibility to reach SDSB visual intelligence.

articleTitle: Teaching Effect of Interactive Response System In New Media Courses
abstract: New media course as an example, the main feature of the teaching innovation is to use the Interactive Response System (IRS) to give students deeper understanding of the trend in new media communication. Break the stereotype of the past, so the classroom can become a field of instant interaction between teachers and students. Using of technology can enhance the happiness of students in learning.

articleTitle: Application of psychological counseling system based on virtual reality technology in college students' psychological counseling
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous acceleration of the social rhythm, from the primary school students who learn to speak in the classroom to the middle school students facing the college entrance examination and the college entrance examination, and even adults facing the pressure of life, there are different degrees of psychological pressure and people's psychological pressure. If these pressures do not know how to release and vent properly, they may develop into serious mental illnesses, which may lead to self-harm or even suicide, thus seriously endangering people's normal lives. This paper aims to study the psychological counseling assistance system based on virtual reality technology. This paper makes a detailed investigation and analysis of traditional psychological counseling methods, understands the shortcomings and deficiencies of traditional psychological counseling methods, and finds out the corresponding solutions, which lays the foundation for the development of a psychological counseling assistance system based on virtual reality technology. Then it systematically analyzes the psychological counseling assistance system of virtual reality technology from three aspects: function, data analysis and data practice. This article focuses on four aspects: user, system function, technology and hardware peripherals required by the system. A comprehensive needs analysis was carried out. The experimental research shows that in the data practice of the psychological counseling assistance system based on virtual reality technology, the case summary of a university for four years was analyzed, and the problems and proportions faced by college students at that time were obtained from it, and it was extended to the participation work. middle. After the crowd, find out their psychological problems and make a summary.

articleTitle: Application of Named Entity Recognition by Self-Attention BiLSTM-CRF to Chinese Prescription Document
abstract: Reporting the contents of the prescription is a time-consuming and labor-intensive task for pharmacists, and it is easy to make mistakes in this kind of work that requires repeated confirmation under the time pressure of customers. Because medicines usually have an impact on the human body, if the wrong medicine is accidentally provided to the customer, it may even lead to death. Therefore, in our work, we train a bidirectional LSTM-CRF network combined with an attention mechanism to perform the NER task on prescription notes and extract key prescription declaration information. The semi-automatic labeling module was implemented using a rule-based approach, and a total of 636 different prescription notes were trained and tested, including hospitals, clinics, and medical centers. The identification accuracy rate is more than 90 % in each field of declaration information. Provides a UI interface for subsequent identification to facilitate pharmacists to modify the identification content and declare key information.

articleTitle: Automatic Multimedia-based Question-Answer Pairs Generation in Computer Assisted Healthy Education System
abstract: Automatic question-answer pairs generation is becoming more and more important, reducing the workload and time of manual question generation. We developed the automatic question-answer pairs generation system for patient education, which can be converted into question-answer pairs in matching video content according to different patient education videos. These question-answer pairs can fully help patients understand pre-and post-operative patient education, by collecting a large number of existing patient education videos in the hospital. The retrieval-based question answering system can query the questions and answers database established by the question-answer pair generation system. The system we propose is mainly divided into three parts. The first part is the text generation (TG) module, which processes the video into text and provides the data required by the subsequent modules. The second part is the answer extraction (AE) module, which aims to extract entities and nouns in the text as candidate answers. The third part is a BART-based question generation (QG) module, which generates corresponding questions by inputting sentences including answers.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Campus Pedestrian Detection based on Unmanned Robot “Sweeper”
abstract: Based on the unmanned autonomous sanitation robot “Sweeper” introduced by Shanghai Sanda University, the target detection technology is studied by adopting the idea of blob analysis to improve the target detection ability and ground cleaning function of “Sweeper” with more than 300 images of campus pedestrians. After HSV thresholding binarization, image morphology processing and image contour detection fitting, erosion operation with expansion operation and different rectangular structured element adjustment, the noise reduction of the surrounding environment and the extraction of campus pedestrian contours were achieved and campus pedestrian image detection is obtained. The test shows that the system can achieve 100% success rate for single pedestrian detection in any environment, and 65%-75% for multiple pedestrian images, and the detection success rate of stable natural environment will be better than that of complex natural environment.

articleTitle: 3D object detection combined with inverse kinematics to achieve robotic arm grasping
abstract: In recent years, the research of autonomous robotic arms has received high attention from academia and industry, so this thesis aims to develop a visual detection system for robotic arms to grasp and place objects. Object detection technology The purpose of which is to locate objects of interest (target) in a given image, providing object location bounding boxes and categories. ROS is a set of open-source software libraries designed to simplify the creation of complex and robust on various robotic platforms. the task of the robot behavior. The proposed scheme uses a camera with depth information and combines target localization and edge detection algorithms to accurately measure the relative distance between the object and the robot arm. The process includes deep neural network construction and use, robotic arm positioning, object bounding box position information, and robotic arm movement control. Considering the visual scale, the relative distance between the target and the robotic arm is calculated so that the robotic arm can grasp the target and place the object in a specific position. This paper introduces how to combine the deep learning object detection model and ROS moveit! to complete the object identification and grasp and place the robotic arm.

articleTitle: Automatic Rib Fracture Detection and Localization from Frontal and Oblique Chest X-Rays
abstract: Several deep learning-based object detection techniques in medical imaging have been proposed. Chest X-rays are widely used for detecting thorax diseases due to the convenience and low radiation dose compared to Computed Tomography (CT). However, the research on rib fracture detection in chest X-rays is still inadequate. Most of the research primarily focused on frontal CXR and some on lateral CXR. No study of rib fracture detection on oblique view CXR has been previously proposed. Due to the overlapping characteristic of human ribs, the oblique view can help radiologists to recognize the fractured ribs that are blocked in the frontal view. In this paper, we employed a YOLOv5 model along with the techniques of data augmentation and image enhancement for rib fracture detection. We trained and evaluated on E-DA dataset, a private dataset collected from E-DA Cancer Hospital containing frontal and oblique chest X-rays. The developed model can detect fractured ribs in both projection views of CXR.

articleTitle: Practical Exploration of Educational Metaverse——A Teacher Training System Based on Virtual Reality
abstract: Metauniverse is a post real world, a multi-user environment combined with physical reality, and a permanent and lasting digital virtual. It is based on the integration of various technologies that can interact with virtual environments, digital objects and people (such as virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR)). Therefore, the meta universe is a network composed of social, networked and immersive environments, which are connected in a lasting multi-user platform. It realizes seamless user communication with real-time and dynamic interaction of digital artifacts. The educational meta universe also provides different possibilities for teacher training, and provides teachers with a virtual training environment that is not limited by time and space. This paper mainly uses the methods of experimental analysis and questionnaire survey to study the design of distance teacher training system based on virtual reality. It aims to tap the advantages of VR, reduce problems in teacher training, and further realize VR based remote training. The design and implementation of the system become possible. The survey results show that when 1100 people access at the same time, the response time is 3.81 seconds, and the server utilization of the system continues to rise with the increase of the number of concurrent users; Most interviewees expressed satisfaction with the design of the teacher remote training system.

articleTitle: Design of Attendance System Based on NAO Face, Speech and Emotion Recognition
abstract: The paper studies the functions of face recognition, body movements, speech recognition, and emotion recognition of the NAO robot and designs an attendance system based on NAO face recognition, which has good human-computer interaction and attendance functions.

articleTitle: HSV Semantic Segmentation on Partially Facility and Phanerophyte SunShine-Shadowing Road
abstract: The previous work reported the importance of visual intelligence on Self-Driving Sweeping Bot (SDSB) to reach the pedestrian security and the sweeping efficiency, in which the machine vision on object detection and semantic segmentation in terms of vehicle, pedestrian, rubbishes detection and road segmentation would be further investigated. Subsequentially, this work proposed an optimizing HSV encoding framework embedded with the morphology operation to examine the semantic segmentation on campus sweeping road. Furthermore, considering the complex weather effects caused the road performed with partially sunshine shadowing effects by facilities and giant tree plants, such that led to the inconsistent color presentation in a road. The experimental results indicated that the proposed framework given the promising results to three categorized sunshine-shadowing images groups.

articleTitle: Design of seat management system in Smart Library
abstract: In view of the shortage of library seat resources and the shortage of traditional library seat management, this paper proposes the design of intelligent library seat management system, that is, based on wechat small program, to achieve the reservation of library seat. The system is based on demand analysis as the starting point, according to the user's needs and its functional module design, so that managers can effectively manage the library seat, but also enables users to achieve remote vacant seat search, seat reservation and other functions, to achieve a more efficient and intelligent seat management of the library.

articleTitle: Systematic Review of Machine Learning Methods in Customer Satisfaction Prediction
abstract: Customer satisfaction is the key of a successful modern business. So customer satisfaction prediction becomes an important mission in Business Intelligence. Based on various studies on customer satisfaction research on different types of businesses, We reviewed machine learning methods used in these papers. The results show that customer satisfaction prediction can be analysed by different typical algorithms of machine learning. Due to the difference between data formats (such as review data or survey data), different models should be recommended respectively for different application fields.

articleTitle: The Research of Innovative Design Strategy for Brand Image in the Digital Age
abstract: In the era of big data, consumers are flooded with a large amount of fragmented information, which makes brand image identity face huge challenges. When everything is developing dynamically, the brand image is no longer as simple as a logo. Therefore, what does the brand identity system mean at this time? The purpose of this study is to provide a feasible innovative strategy for brand image design. Based on the literature and previous study in this field, the development of brand theory is sorted out. Relevant branding cases were analyzed to summarize the definition and constituent factors of brand image and brand identity system. This paper also attempts to show the relationship between the changes of consumers and design strategies of brand image influenced by the development of digital technologies.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality Technology in the Exhibition System of Clothing Museum
abstract: With the continuous intervention of high technology and new media, the visual expression of the museum is also more diversified. In particular, the artistic concept of the Costume Museum is gradually changing to diversification. The “audience-centered” museum design concept came into being. This paper aims to study the virtual reality display system of the clothing museum. This paper discusses the advantages and necessity of applying virtual reality technology to museums. Secondly, the design elements of the museum's virtual reality display project are analyzed. Starting from the dissemination and educational goals of the museum, closely centering on the design concept of “audience-centered”, combining specific cognition, cognitive psychology, human factors engineering and other theories, the specific three elements of audience, environment and technology analyze. Through questionnaire survey and confirmatory factor analysis, a structural equation model of audience experience was constructed, and the differences between the virtual display of cheongsam and the traditional display were analyzed in detail. Experiments show that more than 80% of the audience believe that the way of virtual display can help them better understand the exhibits. Compared with traditional exhibitions, virtual exhibitions are more favored by non-professional audiences, which can improve the audience's awareness and favorability of exhibits.

articleTitle: Cotton Production and Demand Forecasting
abstract: The primary goal of this study is visualizing the tabular data compound growth and forecast area, product demand forecast(from Pakistan and Globally), output and average yield in Punjab, Pakistan. Cotton output in Pakistan's Punjab province and worldwide. Data obtained from government reports from 1990 to 2017 were scrutinized for this purpose. In Pakistan, empirical data showed that area under cultivation grew at a negative compound rate, but production and average yield grew at a positive compound rate. In Punjab, however, the compound growth rate of cotton planting and output was negative, although the average yield increased. Cotton forecasting revealed that acreage, output, and average yield will all increase in Pakistan by 2025. Cotton crop area in Punjab will expand by 2025, but cotton output and average yield will continue to fall. We used power Bi to visualize these outputs. Our results show there has been a significant shift in cotton mill activity towards Asia in recent decades, in particular the People's Republic of China. The OECD/FAO agricultural outlook for this year assumes a slight upward trend for mill consumption in China since 2016. With support for the cotton industry in India, another major cotton consumer, cotton mill usage is expected to grow continuously.

articleTitle: An empirical study on College Students' cultural identity in the Internet Age
abstract: Young college students are in the critical period of the development and formation of cultural identity. Influenced by internal and external factors, the extent and scope of their identification with Chinese culture are variable. The network era is a significant historical background of human society. Like the steam engine era, the electrification era and the microelectronics era, the network era will also lead to sweeping political and economic changes in human society. The problem of college students' cultural identity in the network era occurs in this grand era background and is profoundly affected by network information technology. The Internet has become the indelible background and variable of college students' cultural identity. Young students generally believe that the Internet will trigger considerable changes in the political field and the ideological and cultural area, which has become an important factor affecting their political identity and plays a pivotal role. Problems in network ethics, the network rule of law, network democracy, network culture and other aspects have increasingly become the key factors affecting college students' political identity.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the evaluation of primary compulsory education resource allocation based on TOPSIS Model with entropy weight method
abstract: The high-quality and balanced development of compulsory education is affected by the differences in the allocation of educational resources. This paper takes primary education in Pudong New District as the research object, and uses TOPSIS Model of entropy weight method to evaluate and analyze the allocation of educational resources in each school district. The research shows that the level of teaching conditions in each school district of Pudong is equal, but there are obvious differences in the level of teachers and balanced development. The overall difference in the allocation of high-quality resources is large. Relatively high-quality school districts are mainly concentrated in the middle and West, while the north, East and South are relatively weak. Improving the allocation of educational resources can expand the radiation of high-quality resources to the surrounding weak areas; In weak areas, high-quality schools should be added to improve the construction of teachers.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Neural Network Sliding-Mode Control with Actor-Critic for a Class of Robot Systems
abstract: In this article, a robust fuzzy RBF neural network sliding-mode control with actor-critic for a class of robot systems. Trajectory tracking control of robotic systems has favorable performance for tracking control. The fuzzy RBF neural network sliding-mode and actor-critic method is handled to compensate the uncertainty and disturbance of system. The stability analysis is based on for the proposed adaptive and robust control method. The simulation results show the effectiveness under the uncertainties.

articleTitle: The study on the equity of medical and health resources distribution in Shanghai
abstract: Through the research and analysis of the equity of medical and health resources in Shanghai, this paper provides policy basis for optimizing the distribution of medical resources. By analyzing the resources and general information of the districts in Shanghai in 2020, this paper draws the Lorentz curve, calculates the Gini coefficient, and clusters the districts. The population distribution of medical and health resources in Shanghai is relatively average, but the distribution among regions is extremely uneven. The equity of the distribution of medical workers is also relatively insufficient. The government should improve macro-control, and increase financial investment in regions with weak economic development to promote the rational flow of medical workers between regions.

articleTitle: Research on the Innovative Strategy of Teaching Advertising Design Based on Data Visualization
abstract: In terms of properties, advertising includes marketing and communication. Therefore, in addition to wonderful creativity, a good marketing and communication method is essential to a good advertising. At present, most of the advertising design courses in Chinese universities are design-oriented and cut off from marketing, which makes the works only have creative concepts but weak practical application values. Based on data visualization, the purpose of this study is to explore the innovative ideas and methods of teaching advertising design in the new media environment from three aspects of course concept, method and practical effect. Comparing the curriculum of advanced art colleges in the world and combining the characteristics of local art education, the paper also tries to conclude what changes will happen to the role of designers under the influence of digital technology and what the advertising will be in the future.

articleTitle: Research on HIV/AIDS Epidemic Trend Prediction Model Based on ARIMA-LSTM
abstract: In China, the number of persons who have infected Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (AIDS) is rising quickly every year. Various public health and social issues have been brought on by the Human Immunodeficiency Virus/ Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (HIV/AIDS) epidemic. Understanding the epidemic's development trend is crucial for controlling and preventing HIV/AIDS. Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) is a nonlinear model, whereas Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average model (ARIMA) is a linear model. Both linear and nonlinear tendencies can be seen in China's HIV/AIDS prevalence rates. In order to forecast the HIV/AIDS pandemic trajectory, this research investigates the combined ARIMA-LSTM model. The increasing number of HIV/AIDS patients was predicted using the ARIMA model, the LSTM model, and the ARIMA-LSTM combination model, and their fitting effects were compared. The findings demonstrate that all four models can be used to predict the rising number of HIV/AIDS patients, however the parallel ARIMA-LSTM combination model has a better fitting prediction effect than the other three models. It works better as a forecasting model for the AIDS pandemic trend.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent breeding management system
abstract: By analyzing the requirements for environmental monitoring and intelligence of pigpen, this paper adopts Arduino development board, wireless communication module and Blinker Internet of Things platform, combined with a variety of sensors, to build a miniature model and develop a intelligent breeding management system integrating environmental monitoring and remote control of animal feeding. Pig breeding management system can realize food and water allowance monitoring, air quality monitoring, personnel identity detection, infrared intrusion prevention and other environmental perception. The system can realize abnormal alarm, lighting control, automatic cooling treatment, automatic disinfection and other remote control. The simulation model system has the characteristics of low cost, convenient installation and good man-machine interface, and has certain practical value.

articleTitle: Analysis of the factors influencing online book buying behavior of college students
abstract: With the popularization of Internet technology, online shopping shows many advantages. College students have become one of the main groups of online shopping because of their high educational level and strong learning ability. In this study, college students are selected as the research subjects, and based on the theory of technology acceptance model and personal cognitive model, a model of influencing factors of college students' online book buying behavior is established. Correlation analysis and regression analysis are used to conduct an empirical analysis on the six factors: the usability and usefulness of websites, website security, commodity characteristics, consumer trust and switching cost. A deep discussion on the main factors that affect college students' book buying behavior and the degree of influence of these factors on decision-making is provided, which can be used as a basis for Internet bookstores to optimize their marketing strategies.

articleTitle: The Effect of Employee-customer Interaction on Customer Satisfaction in the Theme Park Hotel
abstract: Theme park hotel is an important place and business that reflects the theme of park. From the perspective of employees, this paper constructs a relationship model consisted of interaction frequency, interaction quality and customer satisfaction between employees and customers. Taking hotel employees as the subject, the structural equation model is used for empirical test based on the questionnaire data. The research shows that interaction frequency and interaction quality have significant positive impact on customer satisfaction, and the impact of interaction frequency on customer satisfaction is greater than that of interaction quality. Unlike high-star hotels, increasing the frequency of interaction may become an important means for theme park hotel to improve customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Vehicle Detection of Autonomous Sanitation Robot in Campus
abstract: Under the COVID-19 and other terrible environments workers are constrained to sweep campus and public area. Intelligent and driverless sanitation robot can solve the problem. Obstacle avoidance and garbage cleanup are its important functions. Based on the driverless sanitation robot project introduced by Sanda University, this paper carries out recognition of campus vehicles and improves its obstacle avoidance function. Through image processing, the object features of different environment and climate conditions are extracted, analyzed and recognized, so as to achieve more accurate recognition of campus vehicles. And opencv and python language are used to complete the implementation of vehicle detection.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of one-stop analysis and prediction platform for agricultural big data
abstract: With the continuous outbreak of COVID-19, it is becoming more and more difficult for individual farmers to survive only by offline production and sales. However, in this context, a perfect and humanized platform system has not yet been designed and put on the market. This system is committed to building a one-stop analysis and prediction platform for agricultural big data. Platform of the main service object for farmers, the use of the combination of online and offline model to analyze agricultural data, online business mainly for agriculture market dynamics, cost prediction, the profit prediction and disaster prediction, analysis of information related to supply reference for farmers and to cross-strait agricultural cooperation pilot zone of offline business provide the corresponding data of agricultural industry, To promote agricultural informatization and agricultural production, management, management, service for the service of effective integration between fulcrum, aiming at the current situation of agricultural development, agricultural products in rural areas are poor and on the development of the agricultural innovation, using the data from becoming more complete information and the foundation of agriculture information construction, to “Internet + modern agriculture” as an opportunity to help farmers set up network information service.

Author Keywords: agricultural big data one-stop analysis and prediction platform

articleTitle: Creation and Promotion of Happiness in New Oriental Live Store Studio
abstract: As the world's second largest economy, by the end of 2020, China had fully solved the problem of food and clothing, and the Chinese people are working hard to improve their happiness level. Affected by the COVID-19 epidemic, e-commerce live streaming services represented by Douyin have provided people with various conveniences. People can meet their needs for communication and shopping without leaving their homes. This paper takes the New Oriental live store studio, which is set up on the Douyin e-commerce platform, as the research object. Starting from the basic elements of e-commerce live broadcast, through the typical cases and data in the two and a half months after June 9, 2022, this paper analyzes the sense of happiness built by the content marketing model of the live broadcast room, as well as the wider spread of happiness brought by user interaction and feedback.

articleTitle: A Friendly Interface Medical Service Robot with Fault-tolerant Voice Recognition and Mobile Phone Remote Control
abstract: In recent years, due to the impact of COVID-19 around the world, there has been a serious shortage of medical resources. In order to supplement the manpower and fear that medical staff's contact with patients will cause a breach in the epidemic, reduce the workload of nurses, and help nurses perform repetitive tasks so that nurses can concentrate more on the patient's condition. Therefore, this paper proposes M-Robot, which is a friendly interface service robot based on the Android system and can be controlled by voice, touch, and remote control in the medical care field. The system is mainly divided into two parts. One is the web server. The web server is divided into two parts: front-end and back-end. The front-end is responsible for friendly user interface management, and the back-end is for accessing the SQLite database, as well as processing speech recognition and semantic understanding in voice services. In the other part, we use TEMI robot to develop and complete the desired service. Its service content includes environment introduction, delivery service, questionnaire survey, broadcast car, scheduling reminder, follow-up record, and patient instruction video. In the voice control mode, the user can say the wake-up word to the robot and say the required service content, and the robot will execute after receiving the message; in the remote control mode, we provide a friendly web interface for remote control. As well as the information needed to manage various services.

articleTitle: Application of online-Pilates exercise based on information visualization training feedback in elderly people with low back pain: a randomized controlled trials
abstract: Objective: To investigate if remote Pilates exercises for older patients with low back pain(LBP) in the post-COVID-19 era may be successfully performed using a pressure biofeedback unit (PBU)-based information visualization training feedback technology. Design: A total of 40 older patients with LBP were randomly allocated to a control group (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{n}=20$</tex>) receiving clinical Pilates training instruction via video link or an experimental group (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{n}=20$</tex>)) with tele-Pilates exercise based on information visualization training feedback. The program had two 60-minute sessions per week for the whole eight-week duration. Pain was assessed by a visual analogue scale(VAS), the Oswestry Disability Index(ODI) was used to evaluate physical function, the modified Schober test was used to measure lumbar range of flexion and extension, and core strength was assessed by the PBU. Results: Between-group analysis showed significant variations in the degree of disability in the intervention group compared to the control group (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{p} < 0.001$</tex>), lumbar flexibility (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{p}=0.02$</tex>) and core muscle activation capacity (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{p} < 0.001$</tex>). And level of pain was significantly decreased in both two groups. Conclusions: In elderly patients with LBP, an 8-week remote Pilates exercise based on information visualization training feedback is beneficial in reducing disability, pain, and enhancing flexibility and core muscle strength.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Personal Blog System
abstract: In order to solve the blogs scarcity problem for individual users in the market, and to meet user exchange and study purpose, personal blog system was born. The system used C# language, Visual Studio tools, and B/S architecture, which was combined with SQL Server database Server and other tools. The system strove to achieve complete system architecture, and completely perfect functions. There were two functional modules that were user and administrator in the system, which could be detailed into popular blog, popular blog, popular album, column selection, fundraising information, advertising application, advertising view, personal center, login (administrator login and user login) and registration links. Personal blog system meet individual needs for innovation, and enhance the basic blog function, while blog serves the people. The system has the characteristics that time and space cannot limit users and promote the dissemination of information and culture.

articleTitle: Research on Machine Generation and Design of ‘Orchid Calligraphy’
abstract: In the era where information changes rapidly, the font design of Chinese character calligraphy library with huge workload has become more challenging. With the help of artificial intelligence algorithms, the Chinese character database with a huge amount of data provides a basic guarantee for the big data processing used in machine learning. Starting from the present situation of calligraphy font design, through the design and creation of “orchid calligraphy” and comparative analysis of “variable orchid calligraphy font” generated by machine learning, this paper studies the differences and connections to explore the feasibility of integration between the two and the possibility of machine-generated fonts instead of designers to design fonts.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Smart Products for the Elderly: A Bibliometric Analysis
abstract: In the context of an aging society and the development of intelligent technology, smart products are increasingly used by the elderly in everyday life. This study reviewed the current research status and hotspots of smart products for the elderly by visually analyzing 377 publications from the core collection database of the Web of Science. The annual number of articles published, the article production regions, and the hot keywords of the selected publications are analyzed in this study. And the research hotspots in terms of user research, technology development, and application scenarios are summarized. In addition, possible research directions are proposed to provide a reference for developing smart elderly products in the future.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of “Angel” Empty Nest Elderly Guardian System
abstract: In view of the fact that the empty nest elderly can not be treated in time, a health management guardian system based on smart devices is designed. The system relies on the smart bracelet and App to carry out real-time monitoring of the elderly's health, so as to achieve the purpose of controlling the elderly's physical status and timely emergency treatment. The system is divided into three parts: acquisition smart bracelet, cloud server and guardian App. The guardian App includes the children's end and the elderly end, both of which are carried out at the same time to protect the healthy life of the elderly. The system can be connected with the community medical center, so the elderly can call for help at the first time in case of an accident, whether at home or outside. The method in the paper solves the health problems of empty nest elderly, and has certain novelty and practical value.

articleTitle: 2D Animation - Q Version of the AIDS Prevention Short Video
abstract: AIDS is a sexually transmitted disease. The medical term is called Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome. Medical methods such as cocktail therapy and anticancer drugs can kill AIDS. Although there are currently cured cases, prevention is still required to prevent the infection from expanding; prevention Ways, like the AIDS vaccine or preventive safe sex, can reduce the risk of infection. We hope that through the production of animated short films for viewing, we can help reduce the HIV infection rate. This short film is presented as a story similar to a micro-film by ourselves. And using the modern scene and the character design of the Q version as the material, the story content is made into 2D animation with Adobe Flash CS5.

articleTitle: Design and Optimize of Campus Nucleic Acid Tests Queuing System
abstract: Covid-19 is more likely to spread in campus than it in other places because students live together without masks. In this case, it is necessary to take nucleic acid tests in a unified time regularly. To make nucleic acid tests efficient and convenient to manage students and the testing time, this article would apply queuing theory to design a nucleic acid tests queuing system by using the data from Sanda University in April 2022. According to the special conditions on campus, such as course schedule, students' daily activities, and campus management, students would be grouped by several management styles. The system would calculate the start time and waiting time for each group and would strive to take nucleic acid tests in an orderly manner with minimal waiting time.

articleTitle: GRAFCET Virtual Machine Enables Digital Twin and Implements PLCopen Systems
abstract: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems challenges implementing programming logic controller (PLC) real-time technology. Firstly, the design of IIoT is fragmented and distributed. Secondly, existing PLC tools are hard to meet and dramatically complicated in emergent industries. Most of all, the deployment of IIoT is state-of-the-art engineering in complexity. A scheme to integrate the GRAFCET virtual machine (GVM) with a digital twin proposed enables IIoT systems in rapidly changing environments. They are compiling digital logic programs that support GVM at remote locations, deploying distributed manufacturing systems through IIoT communication networks, and building operational models of digital virtual and physical systems through digital twin modeling. Its behavior in dynamic operating environments is predictable. The results show that GRAFCET is not only IEC 60848 standard but also IEC 61131–3 for the PLCopen programming tool. Furthermore, a gateway of GVM performs rapid deployment of edge-cloud PLC programming. Significantly a cyber-physical system (CPS) through the digital twin improves the practicality of the digital transformation of PLC's value.

articleTitle: Research on Service Model of Mobile Library Based on Context Awareness
abstract: The mobile library perceives the user's situation and provides personalized information services as the goal. The paper starts with situational awareness as an entry point, starting from two perspectives of mobile phone user situational awareness middleware and service model level, researches and proposes the service model framework of library situational awareness, design context-aware adaptive middleware, construct a mobile library mobile service model based on context-awareness, design a personalized learning system incorporating context-awareness which can improve and enrich the theory of mobile library knowledge service research. It provides a new basis for the development and application of the theory of library situational awareness services.

Author Keywords: context-aware adaptive middleware personalized learning system

articleTitle: Research on Visual Platform for Web-Programming Training Based on Cloud Service
abstract: A practice-oriented online webpage training teaching platform based on QR code is designed and realized Integrated use of cloud services, big data, visual analysis and other advanced technologies in order to improve the teaching effect of Web-programming training courses in higher vocational colleges, which can make up for the deficiency existing in current Web-programming training teaching, such as projects without centralized management, pages can't be viewed online and limited enterprise evaluation. Multi-terminal adaptive Web testing efficiency is promoted, and students' learning interest, practice ability and innovation awareness are improved by using this platform.

articleTitle: Implementation of Mask Wearing Recognition
abstract: Because of the pandemic of COVID-19 since 2020, it seriously affects people's daily life and causes huge economic loss. Recently, the international community has mostly adopted an attitude of coexisting with Covid-19. We cannot ignore the harm the virus can bring to us. In order to effectively protect everyone from the virus, the most basic and effective way is to wear a mask to keep you away from exposure to the virus when going to public areas. Vision intelligence can play an important role in public health issues. In this paper, we utilize the object detection method to implement an actual mask wearing recognition system which can detect if people have a face mask on their face, and send a warning message if not wearing a mask. YOLOv3 is the basic framework for our implementation. After training and fine-tuning processes, the implemented model can perform effectively and correctly.

articleTitle: Chinese Smart Culture and Tourism: History and Future
abstract: Smart tourism has been on the agenda since 2012 under the framework of the smart city development plan in China. After that, the Culture Administration and the Tourism Administration was emerged and become a new Ministry of Culture and Tourism. Tourism has then entrusted a mission of education and culture exchange. This paper did a literature review on the development of Chinese smart culture and tourism, pointed out the major problems of the history, and offered suggestions for future development.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Management of Multi-Connection Timing Based on Bluetooth Low Energy
abstract: For Bluetooth Low Energy application, difficult setting and complicated management of timing parameters in multi-connection between master and slave nodes is obvious. For this situation, a method based on time slice was proposed for updating slot parameters to guarantee the reliability of multiple connections. It determines the value of multi-slots period and other timing parameters depending on the quantitative relationship between the minimum(maximum) connection interval of every connection and multi-slot period. In this paper, a reliable writing and reading method for multi-connection between master and slaves was designed and implemented in TI CC2640R2F platform, on which we made some performance measurements of above updating method. The experimental results show that the proposed method for updating slot parameters based on the writing and reading procedure behaves well in multiple connections for Bluetooth Low Energy.

articleTitle: Effect of Tourist Attraction and Experiential Value to Revisit Intention
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the relationships among tourist attraction and experiential value on revisit intention of bicycle rider participants. It used qualitative method, the bicycle rides on Golden Riverside Cycling Path in Tamsui, Taiwan were samples of convenience into the conduct survey research tools to gather data and analysis. Questionnaires were distributed to 320 participants. In total, 300 valid questionnaires were collected with a validation rate of 94%. Data were analyzed through descriptive statistics, Pearson correlation analysis, and regression analysis. The results of this study are outlined as follows: (a) Based on basic data analysis, the cyclist was in the majority by the male who was mainly marital status, in the age of 20 to 29 years old, college in education, mostly was career listed student and most of personal monthly income is no more than 10 thousand. (b) Pearson's correlation analysis revealed the correlations among tourist attraction, experiential value, and revisit intention in bicycle tourist were apparently positive related. (c) Tourism attraction positively influenced experiential value; tourist attraction positively and experiential value positively affected revisit intention.

articleTitle: An application of machine vision for autonomous robots ‐‐ toy identification and classification
abstract: The paper proposed a system for the identification and classification of toys for autonomous robot machine vision, which aims to solve the problem of cumbersome toy storage for families with children and improve the quality of life for these families. Compared with traditional object detection algorithms, YOLO V3 has a great advantage in quickly identifying the categories of predictive test data sets. The main tasks of this article are as follows: (1) analyze the needs and divide the toys into seven categories: ceramic toys, metal toys, plastic toys, bamboo wooden toys, cloth plush toys, paper toys, clay toys; (2) collect toy images and make VOC datasets; (3) conduct network training. This part mainly performs feature extraction on the data through Darknet53, and then feature fusion is performed on the extracted feature layer in the FPN part to obtain three enhanced feature layers. Finally, Yolo Head is used to judge the feature points and predict the object situation corresponding to the feature points. (4) predict the training results.

articleTitle: A Study on the Influencing Factors of Online Learning Satisfaction among College Students
abstract: Online learning satisfaction is an important indicator to evaluate the quality of online teaching. In order to study the current situation of online learning satisfaction of college students and its influencing factors, this paper combined existing researches and the actual situations and prepared a questionnaire. Descriptive statistical analysis, difference analysis and regression analysis were conducted on the collected data. Through the analysis, it was found that most students think that online learning cannot achieve the same effect as offline learning; improving the perception of task value can improve college students' online learning satisfaction; teachers have an important influence on online learning satisfaction; the online learning platform can basically meet students' requirements, but still needs further improvement.

articleTitle: Beijing Winter Olympic Games In New Media Opinion Big Data Analysis
abstract: The XXIV Olympic Winter Games in Beijing has created hot discussion in new media and social media. The Olympic Games is an important opportunity to build up the image of the country and achieve external and internal publicity. Through the analysis of the new media's public opinion big data, we can see hot spots and public emotions and the characteristics of audiences, which is in line with the mirror metaphor theory of communication and reflects the reality of social phenomena through new media.

articleTitle: College Students' experience of using online video and educational video
abstract: The COVID-19 has made it impossible for students to have face-to-face classes in the classroom. Online education provides a practical method for learning. This article makes an online questionnaire survey in S University (n = 57), describes and analyzes the online behavior characteristics of students in S University and the attitude evaluation of online educational videos. The survey found that watching videos is the main entertainment way for college students to surf the Internet. Students watch 4.5 hours of video every day. The statistical comparison of GPA shows that students can acquire knowledge in online education just like face-to-face teaching. Further research found that the quality of video played a significant positive role in students' complete viewing of video. Therefore, improving the quality of video education will provide better learning services for students.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Comparative Analysis and Enlightenment of College Students' Employment Service for China and Foreign Countries
abstract: From the perspective of comparison, this paper analyzes the core documents in the field of college students' employment services (the documents are from CSSCI and WOS core collection databases respectively), and uses bibliometrics and visualization technology to conduct bibliometric analysis from the aspects of the number of documents, authors, research institutions, classification of literature disciplines, etc., objectively presenting the similarities and differences of research at home and abroad. Based on the literature research of college students' employment service and the current situation in China, this paper analyzes the possible problems of employment service, and gives three corresponding suggestions: 1. Strengthen the cooperation between scholars and institutions of college students' employment service research; 2. Use a comprehensive and multidisciplinary perspective to study the employment services of college students; 3. Build a multi-level employment service goal and form of college students' employment service system.

articleTitle: Prediction of the Epidemic Trend of Novel Coronavirus Pneumonia Based on SIR Model
abstract: This paper collects real-time epidemic data released by the World Health Organization and various Internet authorities, predict the development of the epidemic through the classical model (SIR model) in the field of communication disease, bring historical data into the model, verify the parameters of the model and establish a new model, compare multiple sets of data, obtain the system that is closest to the real data, and speculate on the development direction and turning point of the subsequent NEW CROWN epidemic. The use of scientific and technical means to reason and analyze the overall situation of the new crown epidemic situation provides a solid backing for the prevention and control of the epidemic.

articleTitle: Establish a smart healthcare system with AIoT for Chinese Medicine
abstract: This study establishes an intelligent medical system for diagnosis and treatment of Chinese medicine. Temperature and heart rate were measured using a variety of Internet of things technologies, including the WeMos D1 Mini with ESP8266 integrated and thermistors, and then the resistance was learned to relate to temperature via a neural network. In addition, the AD8232 biomedical sensor and the WeMos D1 Mini were used for ECG measurements and heart rate conversion. A self-written mobile application designed with multiple units to collect data from a variety of patients. The tongue diagnosis unit can recognize the characteristics of tongue substance and coating. The pulse examination unit adopts the five layer pulse method of Yaowangmai pulse. The inquiry unit adopts the syndrome differentiation method of Dr. Shaogong Shen. These IoT data, information if the patient's tongue diagnosis, five-layer pulse examination data and various inquiry data can all be read and transmitted to the cloud. The intelligent medical system of Chinese medicine in this study can also make preliminary treatment recommendations based on a variety of patient data and provide corresponding treatment drugs

articleTitle: Sensitivity Evaluation Model for Line Outage Based on Entropy and Analytic Hierarchy Process
abstract: With the development of economy and society, power customers are very sensitive to line blackouts. Therefore, how to dispatch power maintenance resources according to the emergency degree of power outage has become a prominent problem to be solved by power enterprises. In order to analyze the power line outage sensitivity risk by means of effective early-warning analysis, this paper proposes a sensitivity evaluation model for line outage based on three dimensional data of user profile, outage characteristics and user service. Such an evaluation model comprehensively considers the subjective and objective factors by exploiting the combination algorithm of entropy value method with analytic hierarchy process. The sensitivity evaluation model can be used to provide decision support for improving customer service satisfaction and lean management level of power supply enterprises. Both theory and practice show that our evaluation model can be utilized to effectively analyze the sensitivity of line outage.

articleTitle: An Agentless Private Cloud Maintenance System Based on Open Source Toolbox
abstract: The cloud computing provides the more elastic organization of computing resources, and more efficiency of computing works. However, the private cloud is still necessary to various companies and institutions because of the security requirements. Therefore, these companies and institutions must manage and maintain their private clouds by themselves. The low-cost and effective private cloud maintenance alternative is an important issue to the private cloud. This paper proposes an agentless maintenance system based on the open-souce tool, Ansible. The proposed approach integrate the Ansible with the Web platform. It is unnecessary to install any software on the client machines. The maintenance system can remotely control the client machine to complete asset management, performance monitoring, Risk reporting, and so on. The proposed approach can effectively reduce the maintenance cost for the private cloud.

articleTitle: Advance in Researches of proprioception:A Bibliometrics and Visualization Study
abstract: This paper reports an analysis of the bioinformatics and medical informatics literature with the objective to identify upcoming trends that are shared among both research fields to derive benefits on proprioception for their future. This paper summarizes global research hot topics of proprioception recently based on qualitative evidence from bibliometrics. The research of proprioception is becoming more mature. Domestic scholars can further study proprioception in vision, balance, and other field, and constantly improve the research level in this field in China.

articleTitle: Action Research on Employing Smartphones as the Learning Technology in EFL classes
abstract: English as a foreign language (EFL) classes usually rely on learning technology. A smartphone undoubtedly is one of the cutting-edge technologies. The study aims to make students employ respective smartphones to study in a student-centered approach through which they can enhance their academic achievement and improve their learning attitude. The study followed the step of action research, launched the study plan, and promoted smartphones as the learning technology under the teacher's assistance and supervision. The study adopts mixed methods to collect quantitative data from quizzes, mid-term exam scores, the implementation rate of students' study plans, and the questionnaire; qualitative data were from observation journals and interviews. Data analysis displayed beneficial results for indigenous students in EFL classes.

articleTitle: Instant Message App-Based COVID-19 Outbreak Reminder Service Via Climate-Based Prediction
abstract: Now that the COVID-19 pandemic is serious, in order to maintain the quality of life and safety, it is very important to remind people of the outbreak. Because when the SARS pandemic occurred in the past, it was found that the pandemic situation had a certain relationship with the weather. Therefore, we tried to analyze the relationship between the pandemic situation and the weather by analyzing big data information, and we also tried to conclude the possible pandemic situation and climate-related prediction rules through big data. We hope to use the most popular instant messaging software — LINE in Taiwan to assist in the auxiliary reminders of the pandemic. When people use the weather pandemic robot, they can also find the correlation between the weather and the pandemic, and it also helps to remind the public to pay more attention to their own health.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of Blended Teaching Model Based on Information Technology - A Case Study of “Exhibition Design” for Tourism Management Major
abstract: Taking the Exhibition Design course of Tourism Management major's teaching practice in Shanghai Shanda University as an example, bring the combination objective of course features and teaching goal, and starting from the theory of the cognitive development of constructivism, exploring the blended teaching model. This paper proposes the “Exhibition Design” course as an example, applying information-based teaching method to teaching practice combined with the actual teaching situation, and introducing the blended teaching model from course analysis, teaching strategy, teaching process and effects, which hope to help students to achieve self-recognition construction and personalized growth.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of AI Robot with Primary School Mandarin Level
abstract: With the increasing popularity of artificial intelligence, the technologies used by robots are changing rapidly. We propose a robotic system that can handle Mandarin-related problems, effectively dealing with Mandarin phonetic transcription, multiple-option reading comprehension, text error correction, similarity judgment, and keyword search. The experimental results show that using the national language assessment of grades 1–6 in primary schools, the highest score on the national language assessment is 90, and the lowest is 63, which is consistent with the actual score-provided by Shekou National Primary School for Mandarin assessment. Furthermore, more than half of the average scores in each subject are higher than the low standard (average of the bottom 25<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) and even higher than the high standard (average of the top 25%). Through this system, the machine can reach the national language level of primary school students.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Medical Training Effect Based on PSO-BP Neural Network
abstract: Today, the world is still suffering from Coronavirus disease 2019(COVID-19) and other disasters. Therefore, it is critical to improve medical emergency professional training, and ensuring the training effect has become the top priority. As a result, this paper builds a Particle Swarm Optimization Back Propagation(PSO-BP) neural network model using training data from the National Disaster Life Support(NDLS) course to predict NDLS training outcomes. The PSO algorithm is used to calculate the initial weights of the BP network, and the model is then trained using error back propagation to obtain the predicted value of the training effect. When compared to the standard BP neural network prediction results, experimental analysis shows that the prediction model's accuracy reaches 93.24 percentage, and the prediction accuracy is improved by 11.71 percentage. It is also better in terms of convergence speed, minimum error, global search ability, and learning smoothness. This approach is suitable for medical training effect prediction and additionally to assist the training providers in grasping trainees' learning effects in advance to improve training quality.

articleTitle: Teaching Quality Evaluation and Analysis System Based on AHP-PSO-BP Neural Network
abstract: Teaching quality evaluation as a way of observing and managing teaching has a long history. The data of students' grading of courses and teachers is the data basis of the whole method. According to the evaluation data, the colleges and universities can objectively understand the teaching quality of each teacher and course. Therefore, more and more attention has been paid to the evaluation of teaching quality. The traditional evaluation method assumes that all evaluation indexes play the same role in the process of comprehensive evaluation. Although this method can easily process students' teaching quality evaluation data and generally reflect the overall level of teaching quality, it has obvious shortcomings in the targeted and detailed performance of teaching quality. In addition, how to calculate the teaching evaluation results efficiently and accurately is also the key issue of teaching quality evaluation research. Therefore, this paper studies the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and Particle Swarm Optimization Back Propagation (PSO-BP) neural network algorithm, and designs and develops a teaching quality evaluation and analysis system based on the algorithm. The system is developed with Django framework and HTML5 standard. It can effectively and conveniently evaluate the teaching quality, and provide references for colleges and universities to improve the teaching quality.

articleTitle: 5G IoT Development and Application for Automatic Motorcycle Sensing
abstract: The automation of motorcycle equipment allows users to control equipment more safely and conveniently or use the APP to view information, such as sensors controlling spin pedal switches and mobile phones to view water tank data. This topic allows users to understand the condition of the motorcycle more quickly. This topic uses ARDUINO UNO+ESP8266 as the development platform and is composed of several sensors and a servo motor: it can sense gravity to control the opening and closing of the pedal, detect the function of the water level sensor of the water tank, and check various information at any time through 5G from the APP, To learn more about the health of the car, if there is any unusual information, immediately remind it through the mobile phone, and go to the car dealer for inspection as soon as possible to avoid the situation that the machine cannot be repaired.

articleTitle: An Application of Machine Learning to Policyholder Behavior Prediction System Design
abstract: Intermediately withdrawing of insurance will damage the credit condition even the economic condition of the applicant. For an insurance company, predicting the credit behavior of each applicant is an important step in the risk control of the company, so as to avoid encountering the worst situation of the applicant's intermediate withdrawal. This study attempts to use BP network for building a model to predict the policyholder behavior. We also integrate the results into the policyholder behavior prediction system, and facilitate the internal use of insurance company employees. After all, we hope this can help users make decisions with lower risk.

articleTitle: Intelligent Human-machine Game System Based on Machine Vision
abstract: This paper designs an intelligent man-machine game system based on machine vision, including image acquisition and processing, game algorithm, and intelligent control of robotic arm. The camera collects the chessboard and chess piece images, performs image processing through OpenCV, uses the Hough transform algorithm to find the position of the board and pieces, and extracts the chess game information contained in the picture. The chess game information is entered into the game algorithm, and after processing, the next position of the intelligent system is obtained. Finally, the drop position is sent to the Arduino, where the Arduino controls the robotic arm drop. The system realizes the intelligent control of the robotic arm based on machine vision and completes the function of man-machine game.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting Employees' Job Satisfaction of Shanghai Disney
abstract: This paper analyzes the employees' job satisfaction in Shanghai Disney from four factors of work environment, work group, employee compensation and company culture. According to the result, the performance of employees' job satisfaction from high to low is company culture, work environment, work group and employee compensation in order. The positive factors of job satisfaction include great company culture, immersive work environment, Disney-themed landscaping, training and disability hiring program. However, employees show lower job satisfaction with the factors of irregular work scheduling, pay, colleague cooperation, rotating shifts, and career path. Despite of great culture, lack of belonging is an unfavorable factor for job satisfaction. Different ways to improve employees' job satisfaction are proposed in this paper, including facilitating communication and team cooperation, raising hourly worker pay and offering a career development program.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Quality Evaluation and Group Characteristics of Blended Courses based on Data Mining Technology
abstract: This paper uses data mining technology to evaluate the teaching quality of blended course “Principles and Technology of Database”. At first, the Factor Analysis Model is used to study the teaching quality of the course. Then, we choose K-means clustering algorithm to analyze the student groups with online and offline behavior data, and find out the characteristics of students needed to be focused on. Thirdly, comparing the three algorithms of Naive Bayes, Decision Tree and BP Neural Network on predictive performance, it is concluded that BP Neural Network can better fit the complexity algorithm model between learning behavior and performance. Finally, the teaching feedback and intervention strategies of the blended course are formulated to improve the teaching quality and learning effect. The results show that this research can solve the problems of complex models and strong generalization in related research to a certain extent, which has practical guiding significance.

articleTitle: Development of Intelligent Transportation Function Based on NAO Robot
abstract: This study is based on NAO robot to develop a series of transportation functions to assist people's daily life. Through studying the python library corresponding to Choregraph platform and NAO robot, the design of robot's hand movements and foot movements, the research of identifying objects by machine vision, ranging algorithm and color recognition, testing the success of each function development, and finally integrating a series of functions. I hope I can make a certain contribution to the research of NAO robot.

articleTitle: Determinants of Infant Formula Retailers' Traceable Behaviors under Compulsory Traceability System of China
abstract: In order to improve the effect of the traceable system from the perspective of supply chain, the traceable behaviors' determinants of infant formula retailers are studied in this paper. The mixed model combing TAM2 and TPB is established to analyze 254 valid questionnaires of Chinese infant formula retailers, and a multi-group analysis of online and offline sellers are made. The results demonstrate that the most important negative factor influencing the traceable intention of infant formula retailers is perceived cost and resources. The traceable intention and behaviors of offline retailers are more easily constrained by perceived cost and resources than online retailers'. While perceived ease of use has the greatest positive effect on traceable behaviors of retailers, and it also has a greater impact on the traceable behavior of offline retailers than online retailers. Online retailers are more sensitive to the image and external pressure than offline sellers.

Author Keywords: partial least squares structural equation model

articleTitle: The Research on Practicing the Fusion Mode of Commerce, Tourism and Culture in Shanghai
abstract: The fusion mode of commerce, tourism and culture(or in short, CTC) is the concept of modern urban development aiming to remove the limitation of resource utilization and achieve the optimal fusion of urban commerce, tourism and culture. This paper first elaborates on the meaning of the fusion mode of “CTC”, and then recaps the process of “CTC” fusion in three representative shopping centers in Shanghai, namely, the People's Square, Xu Jiahui and Qibao to generalize the phases and characteristics of the fusion of “CTC” in Shanghai. Pointing out the multiple determinants of the fusion and development of “CTC”, this paper also offers the suggestions to foster the high-quality fusion of “CTC” in Shanghai in the hope that it can be used for reference in other domestic cities.

articleTitle: Consideration of the Safety Context of Chinese Pharmaceutical Online Sales
abstract: The purpose of this study is to clarify the current problems with online pharmaceutical sales in China from the perspective of the consumer. First, the limitations of online pharmaceutical sales in China are discussed with reference to online pharmaceutical sales in Japan. Second, a questionnaire survey was conducted to underscore the awareness and problems among Chinese consumers regarding online pharmaceutical sales. Third, the current problems experienced by Chinese consumers are analyzed using factor analysis in the questionnaire analysis. Findings indicate the potential use of consumer service working with the current gap in online pharmaceutical sales services. Simultaneously, addressing the Internet pharmaceuticals sales-related medical advice and after-sales service. Future studies should determine how to meet the requirements of consumers using online pharmaceutical sales platforms as well as its standardization.

articleTitle: QR-FLBS: A Personalized Location Big Data Privacy Protection Model
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile communication and location-aware device technology, many smart mobile terminal data are generated daily. These data are not only large in quantity and value, but also based on location service, so it is called big location data based on location service. In recent years, large data generated by location-based services has become a research hot spot in the industry. At the same time, people pay more and more attention to the privacy protection of big data. Given the limitations of the traditional privacy protection model based on false location of big location data, this paper proposes a model QR-FLBS (Quick Response-Fingerprint Location-Based Services) based on fingerprint identification and two-dimensional code technology of smart terminals, which can better solve the privacy protection of location services to a certain extent. This experiment adopts the data from real data sets and compares it with the privacy-protection method of false location. The performance of the QR-FLBS model is measured by the response time, robustness and privacy. The experimental results show that the scheme is suitable for the privacy protection of location services and improves privacy protection without sacrificing the quality of user location services.
